OVERVIEW: Perform a swipe gesture from one point to another on the screen.

USAGE: sim-use swipe [<options>] [<x,y> ...]

ARGUMENTS:
  <x,y>                   Optional positional coordinate pairs: <from x,y> <to
                          x,y>. Exclusive with --from/--to and
                          --start-x/--start-y/--end-x/--end-y.

OPTIONS:
  --from <x,y>            Starting coordinate pair.
  --to <x,y>              Ending coordinate pair.
  --start-x <start-x>     The X coordinate of the starting point.
  --start-y <start-y>     The Y coordinate of the starting point.
  --end-x <end-x>         The X coordinate of the ending point.
  --end-y <end-y>         The Y coordinate of the ending point.
  --duration <duration>   Duration of the swipe in seconds.
  --delta <delta>         Distance between touch points in pixels.
  --pre-delay <pre-delay> Delay before starting the swipe in seconds.
  --post-delay <post-delay>
                          Delay after completing the swipe in seconds.
  --device <device>       Target device — iOS Simulator UDID or Android adb
                          serial. Auto-detected by string shape. Optional —
                          defaults to the only booted iOS simulator on the host
                          (or to the SIM_USE_DEVICE / SIM_USE_UDID env var when
                          set).
  --udid <udid>           Deprecated alias for --device. Still accepted; may be
                          removed in a future release.
  --json                  Emit the result as compact JSON instead of the
                          human-readable success line.
  --version               Show the version.
  -h, --help              Show help information.
